messages:
maria: Quick ask — need a compact benchmark tile + hero diagram for the go-live (target 2025-05-18). Mobile-first, 3 variants: latency, cost, quality. Also one 16:9 explainer slide for the webinar. Can we get assets + Figma tokens by EOD Tue? :pray:
kevin: Gotcha. Can we reuse the sparkline from last bench or do you want a fresh metric viz? link: https://figma.com/file/last-bench-sparkline
tara: Which palette should we lean on? Primary blue + teal? Legal flagged a color contrast issue last time.
maria: Use primary blue + accent orange for deltas. Must pass AA contrast for small text. Also need alt text and localization for FR and JA.
sam: I can draft 3 copy variants (short CTA + one headline) and a 1-sentence methodology blurb for the footer. Will drop by tomorrow.
design-bot: New request created: FIGMA-1284 — "mini-bench-pack". Owners: @kevin, @tara. Due: 2025-05-12.
kevin: Timeline looks ok. Two quick Qs: 1) include per-token cost panel on the tile? 2) do you want a tiny inbound-routing micro-flow for webinar signup?
maria: Yes to both. Cost panel should show relative unit cost vs baseline. Micro-flow: signup -> nurture email -> webinar -> demo request. Keep it to 6 nodes max, use simple icons.
tara: Will do static PNG, animated GIF (loop ~2s), and a 16:9 slide. I'll include overlay copy for localization and a separate SVG icon set.
legal: Heads-up — avoid absolute claims like "fastest" or "lowest cost" unless we have a vetted benchmark. Prefer "latency-optimized" or "cost-efficient". Also please include the methodology line and link to the test harness in the slide footer. cc: @maria
maria: Noted. Sam — please add the one-line methodology we can tuck into footer. Keep it factual.
sam: Methodology draft: "Benchmarks report p95 latency across standard generation workloads with default batching; see methodology doc for details." Put in footer.
kevin: Uploading initial Figma file now: https://figma.com/file/abc123-mini-bench-pack — contains artboards for 3 tiles + slide + SVGs.
maria: Perfect. Include accessible SVG exports and a small asset pack for email headers (600x200). Ping when ready for review. :rocket:
tara: Will post first pass by Mon 12:00pm PT. @design-review can you book a 20-min review slot after upload?
design-review: Added review slot Mon 12:30pm PT. Calendar invites sent and reminder set.
maria: Thanks team — this pack feeds webinar slides, launch social, and inbound email. Keep copy concise and flag any legal copy edits early. :thumbsup:
